extractedSignals: RAPTOR is an autonomous security research framework built on top of Claude Code (but not tied to it -- you can plug in your own analysis layer too).
It chains together static analysis, binary analysis, LLM-powered vulnerability validation, exploit generation, and patch writing into a single workflow you can run against a codebase or binary.
It starts from the Microsoft Python 3.12 devcontainer and adds static analysis, fuzzing, and browser automation tooling.
/agentic Full autonomous workflow: scan, validate, exploit, patch Stable
/agentic then runs Semgrep and CodeQL, deduplicates findings, and dispatches each one for validation using the exploitation-validator methodology:
Stage A: is the pattern actually a vulnerability, or is the tool pattern-matching noise?
The orchestration layer is always Claude Code.
The CLAUDE.md, skills, and commands all run as Claude Code instructions.
